no_adcom_quote.quote: We chose not to convene the Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee to evaluate this NDA. Although patiromer is a new molecular entity, its mechanism of action is similar to a product that has been marketed for decades (SPS).

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for VELTASSA (patiromer, NDA205739). The review team declined to refer the application because the mechanism of action resembled a long-marketed product (SPS) and the efficacy trial design and serum-potassium endpoint were acceptable; the ODMemo (L161), Summary Review (L149), and Medical Review (L635) all confirm no AdComm meeting was held. Instead of an advisory committee, an internal Regulatory Briefing was held to address the drug's drug-binding (drug-drug interaction) safety concern.
